_: sword_of_rage_le on Vinch52's 'Black Knight Sword Of Rage LE (Stern 2019)', reworked and
coded by Meakin68 (cGameName bksor, PinUP Player): a scripted tribute, no ROM (its
controller.vbs is only B2S/DOF; core.vbs is loaded by LoadCoreFiles). The table has the
LE's upper playfield (SW80-SW84, U/P target and lock at z 150-255) and its upper flipper,
which the Pro has no switches or coils for, so the LE is the card. Its objects are named
after Stern's switch NUMBERS (SWnn = switch_list.txt `num` nn), so every switch below is
matched by name; ids are the rig's sword_of_rage_le switch_list.txt, which came from the
binary (no run's dump yet): re-check against the shim's table once an LE run has written
one. The LE's led_io.txt is empty, so the lamps use the Pro's LED numbering (see lamps).
PulseTimer is retrofitted: the tribute has none and core.vbs's vpmTimer runs on it.
SW41 (left 1-bank drop) is NOT a mapped switch: its Sub line ends in a blank, which
vpxshadow's rename does not match, so its original hit sub (which drops the target) stays
and PadMechTimer makes switch 92 follow SW41.IsDropped. The right 3-bank 'drops' are
standups on this table: `hold` keeps their switches closed (down) until the reset coil.

extra_vbs:
'---- PAD: Black Knight Sword of Rage's mechs follow the machine
Dim PadPlungerIM, PadSW41Down
PadSW41Down = False
' the machine's auto plunger: an impulse plunger on the tribute's own swPlunger
' trigger (the shooter lane's rest spot, on the plunger's Wall002)
Set PadPlungerIM = New cvpmImpulseP
With PadPlungerIM
	.InitImpulseP swPlunger, 50, 0.6
	.Random 0.3
	.CreateEvents "PadPlungerIM"
End With

Sub PadTroughOut(e)   ' kicker1 pops the ball up onto the plunger, as the tribute's CreateNewBall did
	bsTrough.KickZ = 1.56
	bsTrough.SolOut e
End Sub

Sub PadLFlip(e)
	If CBool(e) Then
		FlipperActivate LeftFlipper, LFPress
		LF.Fire
		If LeftFlipper.CurrentAngle < LeftFlipper.EndAngle + ReflipAngle Then
			RandomSoundReflipUpLeft LeftFlipper
		Else
			SoundFlipperUpAttackLeft LeftFlipper
			RandomSoundFlipperUpLeft LeftFlipper
		End If
	Else
		FlipperDeActivate LeftFlipper, LFPress
		LeftFlipper.RotateToStart
		If LeftFlipper.CurrentAngle < LeftFlipper.StartAngle - 5 Then
			RandomSoundFlipperDownLeft LeftFlipper
		End If
		FlipperLeftHitParm = FlipperUpSoundLevel
	End If
End Sub

Sub PadRFlip(e)
	If CBool(e) Then
		FlipperActivate RightFlipper, RFPress
		RF.Fire
		If RightFlipper.CurrentAngle > RightFlipper.EndAngle - ReflipAngle Then
			RandomSoundReflipUpRight RightFlipper
		Else
			SoundFlipperUpAttackRight RightFlipper
			RandomSoundFlipperUpRight RightFlipper
		End If
	Else
		FlipperDeActivate RightFlipper, RFPress
		RightFlipper.RotateToStart
		If RightFlipper.CurrentAngle > RightFlipper.StartAngle + 5 Then
			RandomSoundFlipperDownRight RightFlipper
		End If
		FlipperRightHitParm = FlipperUpSoundLevel
	End If
End Sub

Sub PadURFlip(e)   ' the LE's upper playfield flipper (U/P RIGHT FLIPPER)
	If CBool(e) Then
		FlipperActivate UPRightFlipper, UPRFPress
		UPRightFlipper.RotateToEnd
	Else
		FlipperDeActivate UPRightFlipper, UPRFPress
		UPRightFlipper.RotateToStart
	End If
End Sub

Sub PadCastleVUK(e)   ' SW45 holds the ball; the tribute's timer003 teleport, fired by the machine's coil
	If Not CBool(e) Then Exit Sub
	If bsSW45.Balls = 0 Then Exit Sub
	bsSW45.Balls = 0
	SW45.DestroyBall
	SW45.Enabled = True
	CastleVUK2.CreateBall
	CastleVUK2.Kick 295, 200, 1.56
	SoundSaucerKick 1, CastleVUK2
End Sub

Sub PadReset3Bank(e)   ' the tribute's 3 "drops" are standups: the switches open, the targets never fell
	If CBool(e) Then
		Controller.Switch(1049) = False
		Controller.Switch(1050) = False
		Controller.Switch(1051) = False
	End If
End Sub

Sub PadReset1Bank(e)
	If CBool(e) Then
		If SW41.IsDropped Then
			SW41.IsDropped = False
			RandomSoundDropTargetReset SW41
		End If
	End If
End Sub

Sub PadShield(e)   ' energised = shield down, the saucer behind it open (GUESS on the polarity)
	If CBool(e) Then
		SW58.TransZ = -100
		SW58.TransY = 50
		SW58.ObjRotX = 20
		SW58.Collidable = False
	Else
		SW58.TransZ = 0
		SW58.TransY = 0
		SW58.ObjRotX = 0
		SW58.Collidable = True
	End If
End Sub

Sub PadMagnet(e)
	mMagnetSave.MagnetOn = CBool(e)
End Sub

Sub PadOrbitGates(e)   ' energised = both top orbit gates open, the orbits loop (GUESS on the polarity)
	LeftGate.Collidable = Not CBool(e)
	RightGate.Collidable = Not CBool(e)
End Sub

Sub PadUPLock(e)   ' energised = the upper playfield lock post down, the balls go (GUESS on the polarity)
	If CBool(e) Then
		UPLock.Collidable = False
		UPLock.TransY = -20
	Else
		UPLock.Collidable = True
		UPLock.TransY = 0
	End If
End Sub

Sub PadMechTimer_Timer   ' the left 1-bank drop: its switch follows the target (the original SW41_Hit drops it)
	Dim d
	On Error Resume Next
	d = CBool(SW41.IsDropped)
	If d <> PadSW41Down Then
		PadSW41Down = d
		If d Then
			Controller.Switch(1092) = True
		Else
			Controller.Switch(1092) = False
		End If
	End If
End Sub
